title: HIVE – High interactive Virtual Environment for the Built Environment
excerpt: Virtual reality (VR) has been progressively used in all industries and has great potential in the AEC sector. At BUILT CoLAB, we aim to develop innovative solutions to support collaborative digital design, construction and virtual management of the built environment.
content:
Virtual reality (VR) has been progressively used in all industries and has great potential in the AEC sector. At BUILT CoLAB, we aim to develop innovative solutions to support collaborative digital design, construction and virtual management of the built environment.

In this context, in order to leverage the capabilities of this technology, we have developed a set of applications and plugins that allow interoperable visualization of BIM models in 3D, immersive and interactive environments, using VR glasses.

In order to promote their use in various use cases, we have created a set of tools aimed at visualizing and analyzing BIM models. Through its multifaceted nature, the proposed virtual environment aims to assist BIM planning and modeling processes in design and/or project coordination contexts.

BUILT CoLAB’s priority will always be to have market approaches strongly supported by research and consolidated by innovation.

Main Activities

  • Specify use cases
  • Promote the use of the Virtual Reality application
  • Developing new tools in a Virtual Reality environment
